quoted.text:
The entire global economy is being held by a single thread of people forgetting to cancel auto-renewing subscriptions and people being too lazy to move their cash to higher yielding money market accounts.

If every human ran a prompt for an agent to do it for them, the banking system would collapse and the world would explode.

如果每个人都跑一个 prompt，让 agent 替他们做这些事，银行系统就会崩溃，世界也会爆炸。
